arStrings.szText:
{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Picking up a {c_important}{u}Storm Feather{/u}{/c} forms a firestorm around you for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds dealing {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} Fire damage every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"|1|]{/c} seconds.

Every {c_important}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} additional {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c} you pick up intensifies the firestorm, increasing its damage by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"|%x|]{/c} but not refreshing its duration. {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c} are now {c_important}Jaguar{/c} Skills and the firestorm is an {c_important}Eagle{/c}, {c_important}Jaguar{/c}, and {c_important}{u}Storm Feather{/u}{/c} Skill.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
